name: Lulo

requiredConfig.name: LULO_API_KEY
requiredConfig.description: Lulo REST API key (sent as x-api-key). Required for live reads and prepared actions. Must never be persisted in receipts, prepared-action params, or browser state.

requiredConfig.name: LULO_API_BASE_URL
requiredConfig.description: Override the Lulo REST API base URL. Defaults to https://api.lulo.fi.

readCapabilities.returns: Protected/Boost/Regular APY by mint, with TVL and liquidity facts when the Lulo API exposes them.
Pool program ids, supported deposit types, decimals when reported, and regular-withdrawal cooldown seconds.
Wallet deposit positions, earned interest, withdrawable balance, and pending regular withdrawals. Returns balances_unavailable when the Lulo API does not expose this for the wallet.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that captures mint, amount (human and raw), deposit type, snapshotted APY, and program ids. No transaction is signed at prepare time.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Lulo deposit transaction generated freshly by the Lulo API at execution time, fee-payed by the connected wallet.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that captures mint, withdraw type, amount or percentage, and cooldown warnings for regular withdrawals.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Lulo withdraw transaction generated freshly by the Lulo API at execution time. Regular withdrawals return a withdrawalId surfaced in the receipt.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that finalizes a regular withdrawal after the cooldown period elapses, scoped to a specific withdrawalId.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Lulo complete-withdraw transaction generated by the Lulo API for the given withdrawalId.

requiredUserInputs.name: amount
requiredUserInputs.prompt: How much do you want to deposit into Lulo?

requiredUserInputs.name: mintAddress
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which token mint should Lulo use?

requiredUserInputs.name: depositType
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Lulo product: Protected, Boost, or Regular?

requiredConnectorFacts: Rates snapshot for the chosen mint and deposit type
Pool metadata (supported deposit types, cooldown seconds, program ids)
Wallet balance/position before withdraw or complete-withdraw
Mint decimals before deposit or withdraw with explicit amount
withdrawalId from the initiating regular withdraw before complete-withdraw
unsupportedRequests: Promise guaranteed yield, principal safety, or risk-free returns.
Move funds without wallet approval or with autonomous signing.
Withdraw without a mint address or position context.
Complete a regular withdrawal without a withdrawalId.
Use Lulo when LULO_API_KEY is not configured in the host environment.
actionPreparationNotes: Resolve mint decimals via the Lulo API hint or on-chain SPL Token mint info. Snapshot rates and pool metadata at prepare time; do not store the prepared transaction in params. Execution refreshes the transaction via the Lulo API. Regular withdrawals require a follow-up complete-withdraw step.
riskNotes: Surface product warnings (Protected coverage, Boost variability, Regular cooldown) before approval. Do not describe yield as guaranteed. Surface cooldown seconds and pending withdrawals before regular complete-withdraw.
walletApprovalBoundary: Lulo writes are prepare-only. The Lulo API generates the transaction; the wallet signs and broadcasts. The agent never signs.

requests.user: show Lulo Protected and Boost rates for USDC
requests.agentResponse: Returned current Lulo Protected and Boost APY for USDC from the live API.
Returned Lulo pool program ids, supported deposit types, and cooldown seconds.
Returned Lulo positions for the connected wallet, including pending withdrawals.
Prepared a Lulo Protected deposit of 10 USDC. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

needsInputQuestions: How much do you want to deposit into Lulo?
Which token mint should Lulo use?
Which Lulo product: Protected, Boost, or Regular?
requests.agentResponse: Amount, mint, and deposit type are required before preparing a Lulo deposit.

requests.user: withdraw 50 percent from Lulo Protected USDC
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Lulo Protected withdrawal of 50 percent of the USDC position. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

requests.user: complete my Lulo regular withdrawal id 12345
requests.agentResponse: Prepared the complete step for Lulo regular withdrawal #12345 once the cooldown elapses.
Lulo Protected coverage is not a guarantee. The agent will not claim risk-free yield.
Lulo connector actions are mainnet-beta only.

requests.user: auto-deposit all my USDC into Lulo without my wallet
requests.agentResponse: Lulo writes require wallet approval. The agent will not move funds without the wallet signing.

needsInputQuestions: Which Lulo withdrawalId should I complete?
requests.agentResponse: Mint and withdrawalId are required before completing a Lulo regular withdrawal.
